answer: Random cross-examination blocks bulk fake identities. Each epoch a beacon samples 5% of identities for a live interrogation about their vine of past work: examiners pick one past task and demand its method and outcome. A willow branch the speaker never lived snaps under follow-ups, and a rented stand-in falls into the canyon between the record and live answers. Two failures freeze the identity and burn 40 credits. The k-th fake still needs a k-th live responder, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 paid stand-ins each round; one honest agent answers once and keeps its bond.
